card.name: Infusion rate limits before the number
card.fires_on: The space or the word 'rate' just before a maximum infusion or injection rate figure in intravenous dosing text. Also fires on a few word starts and middles in nearby drug text.

modes.label: Rate wording before a limit
modes.description: The word rate, or the space after 'rate of', right before a maximum speed such as mL/hour or mg per minute.
modes.example: The drug should be injected slowly intravenously at a<< rate>> not exceeding 1 to 3 mg

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A blank space right after 'maximum infusion rate of', with the number coming next.

modes.label: Scattered word parts in drug text
modes.description: Word starts or middles in drug names and regimens, such as a capital D in Dosing Regimen or the start of vasoconstrictors.
modes.example: Lidocaine hydrochloride solutions containing epinephrine or other<< v>>asoconstrictors should not be used
